envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: Retracting a weighed note said it was withdrawn with no successor; a note the plan takes up is carried by a unit, so it is resolved to that unit.
envelope.cause: operator: retracting a weighed note is not conceptually coherent; it should point at the unit that carries it

payload.gloss: the role that turns the shards the architect hands down into a plan: units, each realizing exactly one shard, ordered so what a unit depends on comes first, sized so one implementer can finish each. It owns everything about the plan, including how each shard is to be realized on each harness, and re-plans, rectifying or rebuilding, when a shard it builds on is found wrong. It never changes the design. The operator's suggestions about how to build a shard, handed with it as idea notes, it weighs by its own judgment, never as rulings nor as grounds to redraw the shard; a note it takes up it resolves to the unit that carries it. Each unit's acceptance proves what that unit changes and no more: a proof costlier than the change, such as a live multi-model run for a wording edit, is a defect of the plan, not diligence.
